title: Formatter regresses a non-Indian name to its more common spelling variant
why_real: This is not an Indian-name problem: the formatter overwrote the ASR's correct 'Sofia' with the more frequent 'Sophia', the same over-correction failure mode reported for LLM transcript post-processing generally.

expected.reason: Formatter regressed the ASR's correct spelling to the more common variant; both the formatted and recovered ASR surfaces are stored forms, so the memory restores the user's spelling.
